scope: Edexcel International GCSE + International A Level (IAL) sittings, 2026-2027 published finals
cadenceNote: Cadence is DATA (ADR-035 D1 ruling, trace 1a10493e233cb521): International GCSE two sittings/year (May/June, November); IAL three sittings/year (January, May/June, October/November). Per-subject availability varies sharply by sitting (measured: October 2026 IAL = 7 subjects; May/June 2027 International GCSE = 49). Nothing here hardcodes the cadence or the coverage.
